blind.B1: No. Human GSE310344: unilateral knee-brace immobilization -> recovery (normal ambulation) -> repeated immobilization; no sampled arm carries an exercise factor (S2.3.p1); post-study resistance training was not biopsied. No exercise words in metadata.
blind.B2: Paper main comparisons (S3.3.p1, S2.14.p1): Atrophy vs Baseline 381 DEGs, Repeated Atrophy vs Baseline 103, Repeated Atrophy vs Recovery 82, Recovery vs Atrophy 536, Recovery vs Baseline 0; n=9 per time point (FIG1 legend, 36 samples).
blind.B3: Yes: 9 participants each sampled at 4 time points (S2.3.p1 repeated measures). Key: characteristics_ch1.2.participant / subject, once per level, 36/36 linked; expression check supported (r 0.40 vs -0.05, p=0.0005).
blind.B4: Paper does not say whether pairs were fitted alone or jointly: only 'DESeq2 median of ratios within Partek Flow ... timepoints relativized to baseline' (S2.14.p1); pairing handling not stated.
blind.B5: 'Genes with a >= 20% fold change (FC) and false discovery rate (FDR) of <= 5% were considered differentially expressed genes' (S2.14.p1); counts as in B2.

summary: 人类 GSE310344 为制动致萎缩/恢复/再萎缩设计，没有任何被取样的运动臂，因此在 design 阶段拒绝是正确的，停止理由有论文 Methods 与元数据双重支持。受试者配对键已被识别并记录，阈值转录正确，未发现 disagree 项。是否把失用模型算作运动研究属于开放的政策问题。
